paragraphs.text: I am applying to Fernwood Analytics. I was a Backend Engineer at Quillon Labs from 2021 to 2024, working in TypeScript and PostgreSQL.
I built a billing API that served 40,000 invoices a month and cut invoice processing time by 30% at Quillon Labs.
I also mentored 3 junior engineers, and I would bring the same care to your invoicing service.
